definitions.gloss: putting (a product) on the market; launch
definitions.explanation: Bringing a new product, above all a new drug, onto the market after approval. A technical term of the pharmaceutical and chemical industries; the verb is {上市|じょうし}する.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新薬|しんやく}→新薬：28055_shinyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{上市|じょうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上市|じょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: We are aiming to put it on the market next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新薬|しんやく}→新薬：28055_shinyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{上市|じょうし}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しくない→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧。
examples.english: It is not unusual for a new drug to take more than ten years from development to market launch.

notes:
USAGE:
An industry term, heard mostly in the pharmaceutical business and its news. Other industries say ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ (release) or ⟦{市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}→市場投入：25179_shijoutounyuu⟧ (market launch).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新薬|しんやく}→新薬：28055_shinyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上市|じょうし}: launch of a new drug
- {上市|じょうし}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: planned market launch

WATCH OUT:
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧ (one's boss) has the same reading.
